cohort: 510 women delivering at different health facilities in central India
finding: 41% of women reported a good birthing experience, associated with factors such as delivery at a private setup, consideration for privacy, good family support, shorter labor duration, consent prior to examinations, vaginal delivery, adequate pain relief, and good neonatal outcome.
mod_finding: Women who delivered with a Dai, were left unattended, or experienced abuse reported bad experiences, while vaginal delivery was associated with good experiences.
